result.question: What were the men lying in ambush still waiting for from the commander?

readings.support: waiting for your consent to their request

readings.answer: permission to bring Paul before the Sanhedrin
readings.support: waiting for your consent to their request | ask you to bring Paul before the Sanhedrin tomorrow

assessments.reason: Matches the text: “They are ready now, waiting for your consent to their request,” which is exactly what the ambushers awaited from the commander.
Paraphrases the stated request (“ask you to bring Paul before the Sanhedrin”) and the needed commander action (“waiting for your consent”), i.e., permission to bring Paul before the Sanhedrin.

result.reason: The passage explicitly states they were “waiting for your consent to their request,” which was to bring Paul before the Sanhedrin.
